executiveSummary: Recent tech news highlights AI/ML advancements, hardware releases, and industry shifts with Apple dominating the scene, while Google and Amazon also make notable appearances.

takeaways.title: AI/ML developments
takeaways.description: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise, and Mesh, an AI-powered contacts app, comes to Android.

takeaways.title: Hardware releases
takeaways.description: Apple iPhone 18 Pro set to become default model, with improved cameras and lower display prices amid RAM shortage, and Google's Pixel 11 phones with up to $350 in gift cards

takeaways.title: Industry shifts
takeaways.description: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon's AI, and ICE wants to give agents electrified gloves that shock people into compliance

worthWatching: Amazon's move to step back from MMOs
Tesla wants to build a $10B solar factory in Texas with Google funding
engineeringPerspective: The importance of considering AI safety concerns, as seen in the Ai4 debate on regulation and open-source access.
The impact of supply chain issues on product pricing, such as Apple's secured lower display prices for OLED displays
